build_phrase: steps back and catches the ball cleanly
takes one touch and opens the hips
holds the ball up before swinging through it
lets the ball run across the body before striking
outcome_phrase: the ball sears into the top corner from distance
it screams low and hard into the bottom right
the goalkeeper barely sees it before it hits the net
the effort curls and dips viciously past the keeper
all the power and placement combined into one moment
